description: This file defines the PGVectorDriver class, a specialized driver for interacting with a PostgreSQL vector store, including connection setup, document handling, and query adaptation.

classes.name: PGVectorDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing PostgreSQL vector store interactions, including connection configuration, document ingestion, and query customization.

methods.name: getPostgresConnectionOptions
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs and returns PostgreSQL connection options, including handling additional configuration and validation.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns the arguments needed to initialize the PGVectorStore, including connection options, table name, columns, and distance strategy.

methods.name: instanciate
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of PGVectorStore with optional metadata filters.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates a PGVectorStore instance from an array of documents and adds them to the store.

methods.name: adaptInstance
methods.description: Modifies a PGVectorStore instance to customize similarity search and query execution, including connection management and filtering.
